notes:
The bug is real and correctly diagnosed. web/src/lib/markdown-import.ts:120 isExportBanner tests /^Exported from umm at\s+\S+$/ against the whole trimmed section body with no /m flag, and export_handlers.go:196 writes '# <name>

Exported from umm at ...'. A space name holding 
 puts its second line in that body, the banner is not recognised, ummExport stays false and every id/canvas/kind/colour/line/connection is dropped on restore. Reachable: store.go:620 CreateSpace and store.go:630 UpdateSpace only TrimSpace, branches.go:89 CreateBranch only TrimSpace, so an API/MCP client can store an interior newline.

Tests do exercise the change. TestOneLineKeepsTheWordsAndDropsTheBreak covers \n, \r\n, \r, trim, no-op and empty and cannot exist before the change; TestMarkdownExportKeepsNamesOnOneLineIntegration drives the real exportMarkdown handler through chi+auth with newline-bearing space name, note title, branch name and resolution, and asserts exact banner lines, the exact heading list and the two line-of-thinking lines. With oneLine reverted to identity, lines[0] would be '# 우리 팀' and the heading list would gain '## 다음 단계', so it fails. .github/workflows/ci.yml:12 sets POSTGRES_DSN, so the skip guard does not make it dead in CI (it does skip locally).
Verified: go build ./... clean, go vet ./internal/httpapi clean, gofmt reports nothing, go test ./internal/httpapi passes (integration test skipped locally, no DSN).

No scope creep: the diff is only the new helper, five call sites in exportMarkdown, and one new test file. No auth, migration, workflow, secret or delete logic touched — exportAllowed and requireScope are unchanged. Output-format only, no persisted state changes, so a revert is clean and files already on disk parse identically.

Content-Disposition is not a new injection path: export_handlers.go:238 still passes the raw spaceName, but content_disposition.go:67 dispositionSafe strips r < 0x20, so the newline is already removed there.

Pre-existing, out of scope, left unfixed: n.Content is written verbatim at export_handlers.go:201, so a thought whose body contains a '## ' line or '- id: `...`'-shaped lines still confuses the importer. Same for a backtick inside a branch name vs exportedLineLabel, and '**' inside a branch name vs exportedLine.
Nit: export_one_line_integration_test.go:100-105 indexes lines[0..3] directly; if the banner block ever shrank this panics instead of failing with a message. Not reachable with the current format.

Nit: the reason/resolution call sites now TrimSpace where they did not before, so a whitespace-only reason yields no ' — ' suffix instead of an empty one. The importer trims either way, so no behaviour difference on restore.
Nit: the file is named *_integration_test.go but its first test is a pure unit test needing no database.
